Sweet Flavor

Barley Malt Syrup

About This Entry

Barley Malt Syrup is a canonical malt-forward brewing and baking syrup ingredient in global cookery — its sweetness character, texture, and pairing behavior pair with dessert wines, sparkling styles, and spice-friendly reds when used as a primary sweetener.
